task: a2a-leakcheck verdicts on known leaks (real labels) and known non-leaks (permuted labels, audit_null)
method: Full-data verdicts on the real labels, and runtime and memory, from `python -m a2a_leakcheck run --strip` in a fresh process per arm. Permuted labels, baselines and subsamples go through the same verdict rule (a2a_leakcheck.analyze: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold by prompt group, macro-F1 with a 1000-resample cluster-bootstrap 95% CI, LEAK above chance + 0.05, 99-permutation test with the rf-light null at alpha 0.05, at least 20 samples per class in 5 groups), without feature attribution, which the verdict does not use. Own connections only. Ports are never features.

methods.leakcheck: a2a-leakcheck: GBT on the header-only features (195 per trace, 35 per agent)
methods.kfp_rf: k-FP features (138, direction and timing only) with the tool's RF
methods.first_request: first-request size alone with GBT (in TCP sequence space, features/first_request.py first_request_seq; role: bytes the agent receives)

reference.definition: Known leaks: the real labels of every attribute but audit_null (and the cells named by --not-known). Known non-leaks: audit_null and the permuted labels.
